title: Contact
description: How to reach ProjectCostKit for corrections, calculator ideas or website work for your contracting business.
body:
The fastest way to reach us is email: **{{email}}**. We usually reply within two working days.

## What to write about

- **A correction.** If a calculator gives a result that looks wrong, include the inputs you used and what you expected. A screenshot helps.
- **An idea for a calculator.** Tell us the project and the numbers you wish you had.
- **Website work.** If you run a painting, handyman, remodeling or other home service business and want a website that brings in calls, tell us your trade, your service area and whether you have a site now. See [websites for contractors](/websites-for-contractors/) for how it works.

## What we cannot help with

We cannot give advice on a specific structural, electrical or legal question, or recommend a contractor in your area. For those, talk to a licensed local professional or your building department.
